## Purpose

Describe the problem, the proposed change, and the public-interest reason for making it.

## Evidence and reproducibility

- [ ] Every new factual proposition is linked to an authoritative or clearly identified source.
- [ ] Official facts, calculated values, scenarios, and unknowns remain visibly distinct.
- [ ] Quantitative changes include the formula, source period, and reproducible test or calculation.
- [ ] Spanish and English content remain substantively aligned when this change affects public text.

## Privacy and security

- [ ] This change contains no veteran claim files, medical records, VA file numbers, Social Security numbers, full birth dates, signatures, home addresses, private correspondence, credentials, API keys, tokens, proprietary Ayala material, or patent-sensitive disclosures.
- [ ] No executable dependency, remote script, externally hosted stylesheet, network call, analytics service, tracker, or form submission was added without explicit security review.
- [ ] GitHub Actions remain least-privilege and every external action is pinned to a full commit SHA.
- [ ] The security baseline and Observatory validation checks pass.

## Accessibility

- [ ] The change is operable by keyboard and preserves semantic heading and landmark structure.
- [ ] Controls have accessible names and instructions.
- [ ] Visual or tabular information has an equivalent text explanation.
- [ ] Relevant manual screen-reader or zoom testing is documented below.

## Testing performed

List automated checks, browsers, assistive technologies, devices, and any limitations.

## Residual risk

Identify anything not tested, any unresolved uncertainty, and the person responsible for the release decision.
